description: Set one field on a landing page section (dot-paths in `field` supported, e.g. 'plans.0.ctaUrl'), or replace a whole section with replaceSection=true. Pass the bare content-section key (e.g. 'hero', 'features', 'pricing') — the server maps it into the page's content tree. Top-level roots like slotMap, config, navigation, siteMetadata are also accepted as-is. Each call creates a new draft version — for many related changes across a page, prefer vibe_edit_landing_page instead. Example: section='hero', field='title', value='New headline'. Footer link scope (section='footer', field='linkScope', value='all'|'related'): the LP-wide default for how the automatic footer columns (source:'auto', autoType side_pages/comparison_pages/blogs) are filled on its SIDE PAGES. 'all' (default) = same lists everywhere; 'related' = each side page's footer lists only the side pages and articles connected to it (same keyword cluster + internal-link graph, max 6 each; falls back to the full lists when a page has no connections yet). The main landing page footer is unaffected. Override per page with set_side_page_section({sectionId:'footer', fields:{linkScope:...}}). Pass `baseVersionId` (the page's `currentVersionId`, from view_landing_page/view_lp_draft) to opt into a staleness check: if the live version has moved on since you read it, the server rejects with a 409 instead of silently layering your change onto whatever is live now. Omit it to keep the default last-write-wins behavior. On a 409, re-fetch the page to see what changed and re-apply your edit against the new draft. Pricing plans (section='pricing', plans[]): `cta` is the button LABEL (e.g. 'Start Free Trial'), never a URL; the link goes in `url` (or `urls.monthly`/`urls.annual`, `annualUrl`). Optional `hidePrice` (boolean, default false) hides the price numeral, period and billing note for that plan (keep price: 0); `priceLabel` (e.g. 'Custom') is shown instead when hidePrice is true. A contactSales plan with price 0 and no hidePrice is also treated as hidden. Freeform HTML sections live at section='customHtml' as a map of id -> { name?, html }. Set one with field='' and value={ name, html }, or replace the whole map with replaceSection=true. The html is sanitized server-side and REJECTED (not stripped) if it breaks the rules: only blk-* classes, no script/style/iframe/on* handlers, style may set only --blk-* custom properties, and every /

baseVersionId.description: Optimistic-concurrency opt-in. Pass the page's `currentVersionId` (from view_landing_page/view_lp_draft) to have the server reject with a 409 if the live version moved on since you read it, instead of silently layering this change onto whatever is live now. Omit to keep the default last-write-wins behavior.

field.description: Dot-path field within the section to set, e.g. 'title' or 'plans.0.ctaUrl'. Required unless replaceSection=true.

humanize.description: Run the anti-slop humanization pass (dash normalization, banned-phrase replacement, and the de-slop critic) over the supplied content before saving.

replaceSection.description: Replace the entire section with `value` instead of setting one field

section.description: Bare section key. For content sections use e.g. hero, features, pricing, cta, faq — the server maps these into the page's content tree. Top-level roots like slotMap, config, navigation, siteMetadata are also accepted.

value.description: New value for the field (or the whole section when replaceSection=true). May be any JSON type — string, number, boolean, null, array, or object — sent verbatim, not stringified.

name: set_landing_page_section
